page.title: Policies
page.description: Bundles of actions you assign to users. Edit one to change access for everyone who holds it.
page.glossaryAriaLabel: What do Policy, Resource type, Destructive and Protected mean?

policy.definition: A named bundle of actions assigned to users to grant a related set of permissions.

resourceType.definition: The kind of thing the policy's actions apply to, such as users, policies, or rate limits.

destructive.definition: An action that deletes, deactivates, or otherwise changes something in a way that's hard to undo.

protected.definition: A system policy kept available as a safeguard and not editable or removable here.

page.failedToRefreshPolicies: The policy list could not be refreshed. Showing the last confirmed data.
page.noPoliciesYet: No policies yet. Create one to start granting permissions.
page.cannotViewExistingPolicies: You can create policies, but you don't have permission to view the existing list. Use the Create Policy button above.
